subject: Up for it but...
author: ZombieTron
body:
the weekend before would probably be better, as it gives a bit of breathing space between the meet up and christmas, but I don't know when the Tigers are back?? I also don't know what time I can take off work yet, if I can get the christmas week off then the 20th would be perfect, I need to ask work about this next week!

Anyways... we are going to be in the UK and are both up for it! especially if it's a farewell to numpty party!! I will miss the little guy! 😢 (miss him now really as he doesn't play with us anymore 😛)

PM us with all the details when you work them out! 🙂
